trust_decision.summary: Content of a git repository named by a ComponentDefinition (spec.schematic.terraform.configuration with type=remote) is trusted: the cloned variables.tf/main.tf is stat'ed (following symlinks) and read whole with os.ReadFile, and any non-empty cache dir is reused without checking it came from the same URL, all inside GetTerraformConfigurationFromRemote.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'Terraform remote loader ... unbounded file read'; the only remote Terraform loader is GetTerraformConfigurationFromRemote and its os.ReadFile of variables.tf/main.tf is the obvious unbounded read.

fix_sites.entry_point: ComponentDefinition reconcile (componentdefinition_controller.go:89 -> StoreOpenAPISchema -> GetTerraformConfigurationFromRemote), and CLI doc/show via references/docgen/parser.go:472
fix_sites.module_kind: shared utility (config read: symlink/irregular/size/containment checks, fix.diff:1700-1964)
shared utility (clone + on-disk cache reuse: Depth 1, timeout, size/entry caps, URL-keyed cache marker, evict on failure)
shared utility (module name validation for cache path)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only one remote Terraform loader exists (single git.PlainClone in non-test code at pkg/controller/utils/capability.go:224); the backport commit's appliedResourcesWithCreator change (fix.diff:5-56) is unrelated release-branch noise, absent from the master fix f6a64398 (fix.diff:1680-1964).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Cache reuse across reconciles (capability.go:214-215): a solver could argue the stale/poisoned cached clone is a cache-correctness issue, not the unbounded-read flaw, and only bound the os.ReadFile.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A normal regular variables.tf (up to the cap), the main.tf fallback when variables.tf is absent, remotePath subdirectories, and reuse of a populated cache for the same URL must keep working; an over-broad fix (rejecting any missing variables.tf, always re-cloning, or refusing subpaths) breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: variables.tf symlinked to an unbounded source (e.g. /dev/zero)
main.tf fallback with the same symlink
poisoned cache reused across reconciles / URL changed
module name with path separators or dot names

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A `vela def init --git` preview that clones the repo and reads variables.tf locally to scaffold parameters
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The command already accepts a git URL and path for Terraform remote definitions; a maintainer could add local parameter generation with its own clone+ReadFile instead of calling the controller utility.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A docgen-local copy of the remote loader (own cache dir, own ReadFile) instead of utils.GetTerraformConfigurationFromRemote
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CLI doc path runs on the user's machine with different credential handling (ref.Client may be nil), a plausible reason to fork the loader into the references package.

O9_family: CWE-400 uncontrolled resource consumption via CWE-59 symlink following on an attacker-supplied git checkout

O10_build.project_tests: pkg/controller/utils/capability_config_test.go:28 (TestGetTerraformConfigurationFromRemote, local cache pre-seeded, no network); capability_test.go; envtest-based suite in capability_suite_test.go for controller-level tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the os.ReadFile in an io.LimitReader (or check Stat size) and stop, leaving symlink-following Stat, FIFO/irregular files, clone size and the poisoned cache reuse untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: pkg/utils/common/common.go:205 reads HTTP response bodies with unbounded io.ReadAll (different sink, HTTP fetch).
pkg/addon/reader_local.go:43 reads addon files with os.ReadFile following symlinks (local addon dirs, different protection).
